impact_budget.method: two-DOF initial normal linearization; contact/soft BE and explicit frozen PD; absolute modal phase sum
impact_budget.scope: initial small-strain base-face impact of this exact fixture; not a nonlinear theorem
impact_budget.anchor: n=0 at first force-producing record in the sustained onset streak
impact_budget.dirichlet_mass_rule: three dynamic vertices each rho*V0/4; fixed apex removed

budget_policy.provenance: C4 plane 5 percent plus 2 dt*vmax axis uncertainty plus total_mass*amax; no dynamic trajectory fit
